questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: Why the COP26 conference was a failure
How whales are affected by climate change
Scientific plans to repair the climate
How diamonds are mined and sold
questions.why: Sam says they'll discuss geoengineering – new scientific plans to remove carbon and stop global warming.

questions.q: How does Neil feel about the news on climate change?
options: Very depressed
Quite hopeful
Not worried
Very angry
questions.why: After listing the problems, Neil says, 'It's all very depressing!'

questions.q: Why are some geoengineering ideas controversial?
options: They are far too expensive for any country
They were invented by musicians, not scientists
They would take hundreds of years to work
They interfere with natural climate systems
questions.why: Neil says some are controversial because they interfere with natural climate systems.

questions.q: What is the purpose of spraying diamond dust in the sky?
options: To make the sky look more beautiful
To reflect sunlight and cool the planet
To give nutrients to fish in the ocean
To make much more rain fall in dry areas
questions.why: Sam says the idea is to deflect the Sun's rays to cool the planet.

questions.q: What could help oceans hold even more carbon?
options: Fewer fish and plankton in the water
Colder water at the ocean surface
More nutrients for fish and plankton
Less rain falling into the sea
questions.why: Sam says oceans could hold more carbon if the fish and plankton had more available nutrients.

questions.q: According to David King, what happens after whales poo in the same area?
options: The water becomes too dirty for fish to live in
The whales leave that area of the ocean
The poo sinks quickly to the ocean floor
Within months, the area is full of fish
questions.why: He says a huge area gets covered in nutrients and 'within three months that region is chock-a-block with fish'.

questions.q: What does Professor Rachael James want to do?
options: Use waste rock from mines to trap carbon
Find more diamonds in old mine waste
Stop all mining for diamonds around the world
Build new mountains from mined rock
questions.why: She says mine waste could be repurposed for enhanced rock weathering, locking carbon into rock.

questions.q: Why does Rachael James think her idea is especially good?
options: It will make diamonds much cheaper to buy
It reuses waste in a circular economy
It can be done in just a few days
It does not need any mining at all
questions.why: She says 'I think that's really good because it creates a circular economy'.
